title: Flint's Stockton House hosts third annual paranormal experience
excerpt: The historic Stockton House and Museum in Flint hosted its third annual paranormal experience.
content:
FLINT, Mich. (WJRT) - The historic Stockton House and Museum in Flint hosted its third annual paranormal experience.

The museum on Ann Arbor Street welcomed paranormal investigators as they took a tour through the historic home, which was once a hospital and nursing home. Organizers say the interest is high this time of year as Halloween approaches.

"There's a natural curiosity about this," said Steve Wood, a paranormal investigator. "It's probably the first time some of these people have gotten the chance to investigate a real home that's haunted."

Wood said he has been investigating paranormal activity for 15 years. He has investigated the Stockton House four times and says the location consistently provides compelling evidence.

"It's always great because you get great evidence and we kind of build on each time we come here," Wood said. "Lots of voices, lots of footsteps. You name it, it happens."

After the tour, attendees were able to look around and explore the house on their own.
